mapper.select: SELECT so.bill_date AS date, SUM(sod.actual_qty) AS originalSalesQty, sb.shop_id AS shopId, sod.sku_id AS skuId, CASE WHEN sb.label_json LIKE '%AFN%' THEN 'fba' ELSE 'fbm' END AS orderType FROM ${tableName} AS so INNER JOIN ${tableDetailName} AS sod ON so.id = sod.main_id AND sod.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN ${soB2cName} AS sb ON sb.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.id = so.so_id WHERE so.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.dict_platform = 'Amazon' AND sb.bill_date between #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY so.bill_date, sod.sku_id, sb.shop_id, orderType

SELECT sb.platform_order_create_time::DATE AS date, SUM(sbd.qty) AS originalSalesQty, sb.shop_id AS shopId, sbd.sku_id AS skuId, CASE WHEN sb.label_json LIKE '%AFN%' THEN 'fba' ELSE 'fbm' END AS orderType FROM ${tableName} AS sb INNER JOIN ${tableDetailName} sbd ON sbd.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.id = sbd.main_id WHERE sb.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.dict_platform = 'Amazon' AND sb.platform_order_create_time between #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY sb.platform_order_create_time::DATE, sb.shop_id, sbd.sku_id, orderType
